title: AI chat history and drafts stay in the browser after signing out
steps: Read logout: it clears the token and user state but not localStorage keys nodbusiness_ai_history:<userId>:*, nodbusiness:chat-draft:<conversationId>, nodbusiness_builder_draft:<userId>:*.
expected: Personal content stored in the browser is removed on sign-out (or kept only with the user's choice).
actual: It remains readable in the browser profile after sign-out.
impact: On shared or family devices, the next person can read previous AI conversations and unsent message drafts via browser storage.
fix: On logout remove keys with the prefixes nodbusiness_ai_history:, nodbusiness:chat-draft:, nodbusiness_builder_draft: (keep language/theme).
